summary: Noah Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing its unaudited financial results for Q2 2026. The filing reports net revenues of RMB619.9 million (US$91.4 million), a 1.5% decrease year-over-year, and net income attributable to shareholders of RMB232.2 million (US$34.2 million), a 30.0% increase. It includes operational updates on registered clients, active clients, product distribution, and assets under management. There is no special-situation event such as a merger, tender, or restructuring; it is a routine earnings announcement.
